Name: Change Professions Remastered
Author: BelLucifer
Description:
A modernized continuation of AmazingAlek’s original “ChangeProfessions” mod — but rebuilt and updated for Stardew Valley 1.6.
This mod lets you [b]re-pick your professions[/b] any time you want — without having to wait for Statue of Uncertainty day, or paying 10k every single time.
[list]
[/list][b][u]What this mod is for:[/u][/b][list]
[*]Testing profession builds on a fresh save
[*]Min-maxers who want to optimize specific seasons
[*]People who hate committing to Level-5 choices permanently
[*]"I Don't want to pay 10,000g to a statue" money hoarders
[*]“oh no I clicked the wrong one at 3am” survivors
[/list]

[b]Note[/b]: Not compatible with game versions older than 1.5

(credit + thanks to AmazingAlek for the original mod idea and foundation)
